MicPermission.micPrimer: We need your mic to record. Nothing is uploaded until you publish.
MicPermission.micNeeded: AKINTI needs the microphone to record.
MicPermission.canStillUpload: You can still upload audio you already have.
MicPermission.recordingNeedsMic: Recording needs a microphone and a browser that supports it.
MicPermission.supportedBrowsers: Safari on iPhone, Chrome on Android and any recent desktop browser all work.
MicPermission.iosSafariTitle: In Safari on iPhone or iPad
MicPermission.iosSafariStep1: Tap the page settings button in the address bar.
MicPermission.iosSafariStep2: Choose Website Settings, then set Microphone to Allow.
MicPermission.iosSafariStep3: Open Settings, then Safari, then Microphone, and allow it there too.
MicPermission.iosSafariStep4: Come back and press record again.
MicPermission.iosOtherStep1: Open Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Microphone.
MicPermission.iosOtherStep2: Turn the microphone on for this browser.
MicPermission.iosOtherStep3: Come back and press record again.
MicPermission.androidStep1: Tap the lock or tune icon in the address bar.
MicPermission.androidStep2: Open Permissions and allow the microphone.
MicPermission.androidStep3: Reload the page and press record again.
MicPermission.macSafariStep1: Open Safari, then Settings, then Websites, then Microphone.
MicPermission.macSafariStep3: Reload the page and press record again.
MicPermission.firefoxStep1: Click the microphone icon in the address bar.
MicPermission.firefoxStep2: Remove the block, then reload the page.
MicPermission.chromiumStep1: Click the lock or tune icon at the left of the address bar.
MicPermission.chromiumStep3: Reload the page and press record again.
